name: bow_short_stave_2
what: a short bow WITHOUT any string: its stave starts and ends at exactly the same two corner tips as the attached bow (bottom-left corner and top-right corner) but is thicker (3-4 px) and bends much more deeply toward the upper left, with tips that flick back outward (a recurve); warm orange-brown oak wood with clear grain and a dark warm outline, a red-brown leather grip wrapped round the middle of the stave, small horn-coloured tips. No string, nothing drawn between the tips
